title: feat(i18n): translate system account & messaging surfaces (zh-CN/ja-JP/es-ES)
body:
## Summary

Localizes the `sys_user` / `sys_organization` / `sys_business_unit` / `sys_team` list & detail pages, the `account:profile_card` page and the `sys_inbox_message` `mine` view (user request). Framework side of a two-repo change — companion PR: [objectui#2489](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/2489).

- **spec**: `ObjectTranslationDataSchema` / `ObjectTranslationNodeSchema` accept `_views.<view>.emptyState.{title,message}` so list-view empty states are translatable.
- **cli**: `os i18n extract` emits `_views.<view>.emptyState` keys when a view declares an empty state.
- **platform-objects**:
  - fill every missing zh-CN/ja-JP/es-ES translation for `sys_user`, `sys_organization`, `sys_business_unit` (fields, options, views, actions);
  - replace hardcoded English tab/section/action labels in the `sys_user` / `sys_organization` / `sys_position` detail pages with inline `{ en, 'zh-CN', 'ja-JP', 'es-ES' }` i18n objects;
  - rebuild the sys_user Security tab on `record:quick_actions` + `actionNames` so change-password / change-email / 2FA / delete-account buttons resolve object action translations.
- **service-messaging**: new ADR-0029 D8 `MessagingTranslations` bundle covering the seven `sys_*` messaging objects, registered on `kernel:ready`; zh-CN fully translated, ja-JP/es-ES cover `sys_inbox_message` (incl. the `mine` view empty state).

## ⚠️ Rollout dependency

The inline i18n label objects only render localized once [objectui#2489](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/2489) lands — the console previously normalized the runtime locale to a bare base code (`zh`) and `pickLocalized` couldn't upgrade back to the `zh-CN` metadata keys. After that PR merges, run `pnpm objectui:refresh` here to pull the fix into the vendored `/_console`.

## Tests

- `packages/platform-objects`: **80/80** ✅ (`pnpm -F @objectstack/platform-objects test`)
- objectui side: i18n 177/177, plugin-detail 185/185, app-shell 1278/1278, plugin-tree 6/6 ✅

Verified in all three locales:
- sys_user 详情:alert「邮箱未验证 / 重新发送验证邮件」、tabs「岗位|会话|关联账号|组织|OAuth 应用|安全|API 密钥」、「分配岗位」
- 安全 tab:「修改密码|修改邮箱|启用双因素认证|重发验证邮件|删除我的账号」
- org 详情:「成员|邀请|团队|添加成员|所有者」;业务单元树列头「名称/类型/业务单元负责人/启用」
- inbox `mine`:列头/空态/行内编辑(ja:「インライン編集」)

## Known remaining English (out of scope)

- Builder toolbar "Unpublished app…" banner + History/Publish buttons (objectui builder chrome).
- Platform role raw value `user` (field data value, not a label).
- Activity-feed audit strings (`Created sys_team "…"`, server-generated).

## Changeset

`.changeset/sys-tables-account-i18n.md` — minor for `@objectstack/spec` / `@objectstack/cli` / `@objectstack/service-messaging`, patch for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.
